title: [DOCS] Clocking contract drift: frame-atomic RX handoff unowned, 02 sec 2 still says async reset (REQ-REU-003)
body:
[A10] Found by the compliance-matrix audit of `docs/00_MILAN_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW.md` at main 6a878f6 (owner request, 2026-09-18). The matrix Cov column grades the ORIGINAL architecture document; this ticket records what the tree carries today. Baseline at that head: `./scripts/run_suites.sh` exit 0 (30 of 30 suites, 14790 checks), `./scripts/lint_hdl.sh` exit 0.

## REQ-REU-003 (project charter, design) - audit verdict PARTIAL

One core clock domain; MAC boundaries cross via dual-clock FIFOs with frame-atomic handoff

- In `hdl/` today: One core clock: all 130 always_ff blocks in hdl/ are @(posedge clk_i) and no second clock input exists (grep over hdl/*.sv); hdl/README.md:27-29 'no CDC primitive ... every clock crossing is the integrator's'; docs/guides/integrator.md:24-38. The contract is docs/architecture/02_interfaces.md:57-97 (F02.2 + rules 1-5). Two parts of that contract have no home: (1) frame-atomic handoff ('visible only when complete + good, or dropped', 02_interfaces.md:89-90) - the landed RX face has no err/abort input (hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv:198-201; 02_interfaces.md:101-108) and the integrator guide's MAC-face section never tells the integrator that only complete, FCS-good frames may be presented (docs/guides/integrator.md section 3); (2) reset: 02_interfaces.md:95 says 'asynchronous assert, synchronous release' but the RTL and both guides are synchronous-only (hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv:162; docs/guides/integrator.md:29; docs/guides/hdl-engineer.md:61).
- In `tb/` today: Ver column is '-'. No suite can grade a FIFO that is not in the tree; tb/rx_validator (393/393) grades length/cdl rules, not an aborted frame, because the face has no abort.
- Missing: State the frame-atomic obligation where the integrator reads it (integrator guide section 3: present only complete, FCS-good frames; there is no err input), and reconcile 02 section 2 rule 5 with the synchronous-only reset the RTL and guides mandate. Related, not owning: issue #27 (obsolete class-A word-stream contract).
- Searched with: cdc|async_fifo|dual.?clock|gray|synchroni[sz]er|rx_clk|tx_clk (hdl/); always_ff sensitivity lists (hdl/); fcs|atomic|drop|complete (docs/guides/integrator.md); asynchronous assert|synchronous|rst_n (docs/) (confidence: medium)

## Acceptance

1. docs/guides/integrator.md section 3 states that the RX FIFO must deliver only complete, FCS-good frames because the byte face has no err/abort
2. 02_interfaces.md section 2 rule 5 matches the synchronous active-low rst_n of the RTL and guides
3. REQ-REU-003 Arch/Doc cells name the integrator as the owner of the dual-clock FIFOs

Matrix finding link: GAP-10.

Executor and reviewers: assigned when the lane opens.
